rejected_rule.statement: All co-owners must be joined as parties to an action for partition of a common property, unless the Court is satisfied that it will not prejudice any of them.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "It is well settled in this court that all co-owners must be joined as parties to an action for partition of a common property. The only exception is where the Court is satisfied that the joinder of some or all of the co-owners would prejudice their rights, but such an exception has not been made out in the present case."

meta.parties: Mudiyanse Et Al. v. Silva Et Al
